name: Thunder
overview: Scripture reveals thunder as a powerful manifestation of God's presence and judgment, demonstrated when the LORD sent thunder and hail upon Egypt as a plague (Exodus 9:23) and during the awe-inspiring events on Mount Sinai where thunder accompanied divine revelation (Exodus 19:16, 19). Thunder also serves as a sign of divine anger and correction, as seen when Samuel called upon the LORD to send thunder and rain to convict the people of their wickedness (1 Samuel 12:17-18). Ultimately, thunder testifies to the incomprehensible power of God, a force beyond human understanding (Job 26:14).
